selectedProfile.decoder: Exact nominal software pulse/space durations, LSB-first 8-bit address and command with inverse-byte validation, terminal nonzero timeout. Repeat ignored; NECX, NEC32, inverse mismatch, overflow, frequency packets and incomplete/noisy capture do not produce candidates.
selectedProfile.canonicalEnvelope: ASCII IRR1,u16be count,67 u32be timings;274 bytes. No carrier field or measured frequency.

candidate: Opaque candidateId and demodulated hash bind one capture. reviewRequired=true,captureTimeKnown=false,carrierFrequency=unknown,physicalReceipt=unverified,applianceMeaning=unknown,targetAcknowledgement=false,observedTargetState=false. No automatic learning, persistence, emitter calls or codebook changes. Owner review and later immutable emitter configuration remain an explicit unimplemented acceptance step.
publicProjection: Ordinary public property read uses existing scalar fields: candidateSequence and 32 digest bytes, plus profile data. Metadata reconstructs exact candidateId as candidate-{sequence}-{first16hexhash}. This avoids adding a nested-text schema while preserving exact capture identity.
authorityAndLifetime: Private receiver activation and each capture approval remain separate from public read authorization. Public authority matches principal/application/session/source/sink/read/write exactly. Original owner/control/capture/caller signals and earliest effective deadline stay binding after publication. Stop/revoke/cancel/deadline/session expiry withdraw the public candidate synchronously before provider settlement.
ownership: Exact selected provider object has one in-process owner token. A shared unresolved retirement promise is installed before detach, withdrawal, abort or provider callbacks. Reentrant Stop/close joins one cleanup chain: provider Stop, operation plus first settlement, one close and final settlement before exact-token release. Callback faults cannot skip cleanup. No cross-process or physical receiver exclusivity claim.
softwareProducer: Each activation starts an independently owned Node child with generation and random128-bit token; faithfully produces bounded MODE2 full-frame packets and timeout. Seven actual child lifecycles finish with zero waiters/timers and no running child. No hardware, network, firmware or emitter path.
